data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word ‘khanum’ meaning 'lady', 'woman', or 'noblewoman'. This title was given to the wife of a Khan, a Persian or Turkish ruler, reflecting her status and dignity. The name Khanum carries the meaning “Lady, woman, noblewoman” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khanum usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, woman, noblewoman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
